statement.p: For the following sequence, state the next three terms.
What type of sequence is this?

solution.p: We notice that each element is 3 times the previous. This makes it exponential. Thus the missing elements are \displaystyle{324}\cdot{3}, \displaystyle{324}\cdot{3}^{{2}}, \displaystyle{324}\cdot{3}^{{3}}.
